records.grounds: episode file naming with an underscore inside the SxxEyy token (S04_E23) — the matcher's separator class accepts it, but no real anime release uses it: 0 of 1,270 real file names (572 in the catalog + 698 fetched live from the NekoBT search/torrents API) contain a separator other than none between S## and E##

multi-episode range file naming (S04E20-E24) — a real case does not exist: 0 of the 60 real torrents in the catalog contain a range name, and none of the 698 file names fetched live from the NekoBT API

a file named after a series title that carries **no synonyms** — the named-season strategy has to work without them. The with-synonyms half has a real instance (Attack on Titan's season-1 batch, "[MiniMTBB] Shingeki no Kyojin - 01"), but no real release is named after a title that has an empty synonym list: 0 of the 17 empty-synonym titles in the corpus (plus ~90 media checked live) appear in any captured torrent name
